run_plot_f1_benchmark: run plot_f1.py to generate a bar chart of CarRacingF1 benchmark results from CSV files
run_parse_args: run parse_args to parse CLI arguments for result path, files, labels, and plot options
run_agg_test_episodes_by_seed: run agg_test_episodes_by_seed to compute mean statistics across test episodes grouped by seed
run_plot_bar_chart: run the main block to plot a bar chart with mean test returns and standard error bars
run_save_figure: run plot_f1.py with --savename to save the generated benchmark comparison plot as a PDF
